```artifact
Statechart for U12_Alarms System

1. Start
2. Idle
3. Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring
4. Blower Power System Temperature Monitoring
5. Battery Temperature Monitoring
6. Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm
7. Blower Power System Temperature Too High Alarm
8. Battery Temperature Too High Alarm
9. Safety Action Invocation
10. Battery Failure Alarm
11. End

Transitions:
- From Idle to Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring (on temperature sensing)
- From Blower Motor Temperature Monitoring to Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm (on threshold exceeded)
- From Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm to Safety Action Invocation (automatic)
- From Safety Action Invocation to End (on action completed)
- From Idle to Blower Power System Temperature Monitoring (on temperature sensing)
- From Blower Power System Temperature Monitoring to Blower Power System Temperature Too High Alarm (on threshold exceeded)
- From Blower Power System Temperature Too High Alarm to Safety Action Invocation (automatic)
- From Safety Action Invocation to End (on action completed)
- From Idle to Battery Temperature Monitoring (on temperature sensing)
- From Battery Temperature Monitoring to Battery Temperature Too High Alarm (on threshold exceeded)
- From Battery Temperature Too High Alarm to Safety Action Invocation (automatic)
- From Safety Action Invocation to End (on action completed)
- From Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm to Battery Failure Alarm (on battery temperature too high)
- From Battery Power System Temperature Too High Alarm to Battery Failure Alarm (on battery temperature too high)
- From Battery Temperature Too High Alarm to Safety Action Invocation (automatic)

Guards:
- Temperature sensing is active
- Threshold is specified
- Battery temperature is too high

- From Battery Temperature Too High Alarm to Safety Action Invocation (automatic)
- From Safety Action Invocation to End (on action completed)
- From Blower Motor Temperature Too High Alarm to Battery Failure Alarm (on battery temperature too high)

- From Battery Temperature Too High Alarm to Safety Action Invocation (automatic)
```
